Why go: a newer speedboat at one of the lowest charter prices

Marine Apple is a 2025 twin-outboard speedboat with a bow lounge, a sound system and a marine toilet, and it offers some of the lowest private charter prices on Koh Samui for up to 10 guests. Short trips start at the same price for a sunset run or a morning on the southern islands, and longer days reach Koh Tao and Sail Rock.

What you'll do

From Bang Rak near the Big Buddha, pick your route. A 2-hour sunset loops the north coast. Half days go south to Koh Tan and Koh Madsum, or north to Koh Phangan. Full days add Koh Rap in the south, Ang Thong Marine Park from 16 December, or Koh Tao with either Koh Nang Yuan or Sail Rock for some of the best snorkelling in the Gulf.

Who it suits

  • Families and groups of 6–10 who want a private boat on a sensible budget.
  • Strong snorkellers and divers who want to see Sail Rock on their own schedule.
  • Groups staying on Koh Phangan, who can be collected from any pier there.

Who should choose something else

  • Groups larger than 15: see Sao, which takes 40.
  • Couples wanting a slower sunset with drinks served: a sailing yacht such as Independence.

Good to know

  • Sail Rock: it is open water with current; it suits confident swimmers, and the crew provides life jackets.
  • Sea: October to December is the windiest period; long routes may be swapped for sheltered ones.
  • Fees: bring cash for Ang Thong, Koh Nang Yuan and Pig Island.

Before you book

Choose a route and a morning or afternoon slot for the half days. For the Sail Rock day, tell us if anyone is a certified diver so we can ask about adding dives. Groups staying on Koh Phangan should mention their pier.
